messages:
Maria Gonzalez: Quick heads-up — vendor asked for retest windows after our recent fixes. Can we lock slots next week? Need service owners, evidence plan, and RBAC/KMS checklist. TL;DR: three short windows (canary / staging / prod-sim), ephemeral assessor role, KMS audit export. :calendar:
Sam Patel: I can own inference-runtime + dedicated GPU pools. Prefer Wed 09:00-11:00 PST for our slot.
Ryan Lee: I’ll take api-gateway + auth. Prefer Tue 13:00-15:00 PST. Need confirmation on KMS key access for assessor (ephemeral role).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled dry-run deployment for staging at 1765435800 — tagging with `pt-dryrun`. /cc @Maria Gonzalez @Sam Patel :robot_face:
Maria Gonzalez: Two asks before we send dates to vendor: 1) short smoke test checklist per service 2) where to deposit evidence (readroom location + manifest). Plan: s3://redwood-pt-readroom/<engagement-id>/, we’ll provide presigned upload links.
Jess Carter: Draft smoke checklist (very small):
1) auth flow: token issue + refresh
2) inference request (small payload, ~100 tokens)
3) streaming responses validated
4) metrics emission: latency & CPU counters present
Example curl for staging:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer test' https://staging.api.redwood/api/v1/predict -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
Anita Singh: KMS note: we’ll create an assessor IAM role with GetDecrypt only for test keys, timebound (3h). I’ll prepare a key policy and enable CloudTrail -> KMS data events for the key. Security review needed for the policy.
Maria Gonzalez: @Anita please paste role ARN + key id when ready. Vendor also requested a sample of KMS audit logs showing key usage in the 24h before the retest.
Ryan Lee: For RBAC changes, can we reuse the pre-approved ephemeral role flow? Steps: create role, add to `assessor-readonly` group, issue STS creds via our token service. Ops, confirm STS TTL limit (we use 3h last I checked).
Sam Patel: Pushed a quick remediation matrix for tracking — please add commit SHAs and artifact links:
```
Service | Fix | Owner | Status | Evidence
inference-runtime | restrict debug ports | Sam Patel | in-progress | /readroom/inference/debug-scan.log
api-gateway | auth header bypass patched | Ryan Lee | ready | /readroom/apigw/patch-201.json
console | audit indices retention fixed | Jess Carter | done | /readroom/console/audit-202.json
```
Maria Gonzalez: Please update the matrix with PR numbers and evidence upload links before EOD Friday. We’ll publish final retest slots to vendor on Monday. :+1:
Ryan Lee: One potential blocker: prod-sim retest requires a fallback model route to avoid impact. Ops, can we stage a fallback and confirm 5% traffic diversion?
Daniel Park: I can run the fallback script in dry-run and then enact it. Command I'll use:
```
./scripts/divert_traffic.sh --service api-gateway --pct 5 --tag pt-retest --dry-run
```
I’ll report back with a dry-run log.
Maria Gonzalez: Final checklist before vendor handoff:
- Presigned evidence upload link + manifest file
- Ephemeral role ARN and STS issuance procedure
- CloudTrail/KMS export snapshot (sample)
- Per-service smoke checklist (owner-signed)
- Retest slot owner + on-call contact
If no objections I’ll send the proposed windows to the vendor by EOD today. :calendar: :hammer:
